meta.title: Kinematic Viscosity Converter — Convert Square meter/second and M
meta.description: Free kinematic viscosity converter for 5+ units including Square meter/second, Square millimeter/second, Stokes. Instant, accurate, browser-based.

content.intro: m²/s, stokes, centistokes. Convert between 5 kinematic viscosity units instantly, with engineering-grade precision and no signup required.
content.result_section: Pick any two units below to convert between them. The base unit for kinematic viscosity in this tool is **m2s**; every conversion routes through it for consistency.
content.formula_section: Most kinematic viscosity conversions are a single multiplication by a fixed factor. Temperature is the notable exception — it uses additive offsets, not just multiplication. The converter handles both transparently.
content.conversion_table:
| Unit | Symbol |
| --- | --- |
| Square meter/second | m²/s |

content.use_cases:
- Recipe scaling and bartending where measures span metric and imperial.
- Fuel economy comparisons across regions.
- Lab dosing and reagent prep across mL, L, and US/UK units.
- Aquarium, pool, and tank capacity calculations.
- Shipping fluid product specs across markets.
content.tips:
Bookmark the conversions you use most — each pair has its own dedicated page with formulas, a lookup table, and FAQs.

When working with derived units (area, volume), remember the factor scales with the dimension: a length factor f becomes f² for area and f³ for volume.
content.faq:
